name: @codai/glass-mcp-cli
stderr:
Usage: glassmcp [options] [command]

Command-line interface for GlassMCP - Machine Control Protocol

Options:
  -V, --version             output the version number
  -c, --config <path>       path to config file
  -v, --verbose             enable verbose logging
  --server <url>            server URL (overrides config)
  --token <token>           authentication token (overrides config)
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  connect [options]         Connect to GlassMCP server
  status [options]          Check server status
  playground [options]      Interactive playground for testing GlassMCP
  enterprise|ent [options]  Enterprise management commands
  help [command]            display help for command
